results.title: asyncio.TaskGroup
results.snippet: Structured concurrency: tasks started in the group are awaited, and one failure cancels the rest.
results.content: async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg: tg.create_task(...). On exit the group waits for its tasks; if one raises, the others are cancelled and the errors are raised together as an ExceptionGroup. Prefer it to bare gather() for new code.
